text.p: HFS Inc said Monday its subsidiary Avis Rent A Car Inc completed a $3.65 billion asset-backed financing, supported by vehicles and receivables from automobile manufacturers.

The company said $1.65 billion of the financing relates to three and five year Medium Term Notes, which are supported by a surety bond issued by MBIA. The notes are rated "Aaa" by Moody's Investors Service and "AAA" by Standard and Poor's, it said.

Avis also launched a $2 billion asset-backed commercial paper program, rated "P-1" by Moody's and "A-1" by Standard & Poor's and backed by a $1.8 billion liquidity facility and $200 million Letter of Credit.
Avis filed with the Securities and Exchange Commission for an initial public offering in June 1997.
